title: Rulers and guides
description: Horizontal and vertical pixel rulers along stage edges (View > Rulers). Drag from rulers to create guide lines; drag guide off stage to delete. Snap-to-guides (View > Snapping). Store guides in DocumentProperties.guides array. See docs/01-documents-stage-scenes.md (Rulers/Guides). Depends on stage-view-mvp, document-model-mvp.
